newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-SCHALKE START LEAGUE CAMPAIGN WITH A WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SCHALKE START LEAGUE CAMPAIGN WITH A WIN.

text.p: UEFA Cup winners Schalke made a winning start to their German league campaign on Friday, coming from behind to beat Bayer Leverkusen 2-1.
Ulf Kirsten, last season's Bundesliga top scorer, put Leverkusen ahead in the 10th minute after a poor clearance from Schalke goalkeeper Jens Lehmann.
But the Gelsenkirchen side, watched by more than 48,000 spectators, struck back with second-half goals rom Dutchmen Johan de Kock and and Marco van Hoogdalem.
The result was a major disappointment for Leverkusen, last season's runners-up who have declared they want to go one better this time.
Another potential title contender, VfB Stuttgart, also got off to a disappointing start. The German Cup winners had to settle for a 1-1 draw at home to 1860 Munich.
Bulgarian international Krasimir Balakov put Stuttgart ahead with a delightful free kick in the 22nd minute.

The home side continued to dominate despite having defender Marco Haber sent off in the 40th minute for persistent fouling. But 1860 stole a point thanks to a Bernhard Winkler goal just two minutes from time.
